regions.text:
Of course there are some differences in our bodies because of which some
biological functions like giving birth, producing milk etc can happen only
in female bodies. We understand that other than that, there are no limits
that nature has set. Society makes these rules and we, as members of the
society can change them!
Make groups of 4 - Discuss which jobs you have been told not to do
because of your gender. How does that make you feel?
Household
Home builder
Doctor
Carpenter
management
-
Time with Teacher - List what each person in the class wants to do/
learn now - and what job or work they would like to do once they are an
adult. Discuss how you can speak with the people who are forcing gender
roles on you in a respectful and assertive manner.
Think and Do: What would you say to someone who tells you
that you can't do something because you're a girl or boy?
What are some respectful and assertive ways to respond?
Anyone can do any
job. Gender does
not determine or
limit what we can
do or achieve.
25
